purpose: The install-tree identity rendered into README.md for the 0.0.46 candidate. The artefacts were rebuilt from the frozen source at measured_source_commit by the canonical recipe; this receipt binds the rendered identity to the bytes that build actually produced.

source_identity.measured_source_commit_subject: ledger: apply B48 after independent adjudication (76 discharged, RC2-001 retained)
source_identity.build_source_tree_digest_rule: sha256 over canonical JSON of sorted [relpath, size, sha256] for src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs (forensics/tools/phase7_courts.py::_source_tree_digest)
source_identity.release_tree_digest_rule: same rule and same enumeration, computed over the 0.0.46 packaging tree (this commit's Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock at 0.0.46).
source_identity.release_tree_digest_note: The release and build enumerations coincide because the 0.0.46 version bump is committed before this build; unlike 0.0.45 there is no post-build manifest delta to record.
source_identity.working_tree_at_build: clean at fadca9328 before the build; the rebuild is what dirtied the tracked artefacts, and they are not committed by this receipt.

build.why_rebuilt: the receipt must carry artefact hashes produced by an actual build of the frozen source; the previously committed artefacts were built at an earlier candidate, so their hashes could not be asserted for 0.0.46.

evidence_carried_forward.closure: the applied closure is not re-measured at this candidate; this receipt binds build identity only.
evidence_carried_forward.why: re-running the safety closure is a deliberate verification activity, not part of packaging.
evidence_carried_forward.mechanism_discharges: none claimed here; the ledger at measured_source_commit is the authority.

non_claims: No obligation is discharged by this receipt, and none is discharged by rebuilding.
The closure and downstream evidence are not re-measured at 0.0.46.
Passing the Phase 2 courts is an ABI/install-layout result, not a safety or cryptographic result.
The export counts are unchanged from 0.0.45; the artefact bytes differ because the source and build inputs differ, which is not a regression and not a safety result.
